name: Kerecsen Szabó
summary: I turn complex business needs into reliable, scalable ML products, combining Python software engineering depth with production ML and data platform experience.

Across 8+ years in software, data and machine learning, I have built forecasting and RAG-enabled applications, real-time model-serving systems and distributed data pipelines, working with stakeholders from requirements through deployment, testing and production support.
I apply test-driven development and clean-code practices to build cloud-native applications optimised for distributed computing.

Use GitHub Copilot for code generation, pull-request review and conversational exploration of codebases, with human review of suggested changes.
Apply advanced prompt engineering and stay current with new AI models and their capabilities.

Build reproducible benchmarks for local LLMs across model families and sizes, evaluating structured-output reliability, relevance, grounding, latency and resource use to select models for production workflows.
